conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: A recommendation system is an algorithm that suggests relevant items to users based on their past behavior and preferences. It analyzes data to predict what a user might be interested in.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent

conversation.message: That's interesting. So, how do they handle privacy with all that data?

conversation.speaker: ai_agent

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: Many systems use federated learning, where models are trained on local devices without centralizing personal data. Differential privacy also adds statistical noise to data to protect individual privacy while retaining overall data utility.
